queries:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT ID,
         AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic,
         AVG(HGB) * 1.0 / AVG(HCT) AS ratio
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
),
m AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM p WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(p.avg_pic) AS avg_pic,
       AVG(p.ratio) AS avg_ratio,
       AVG(p.ratio - m.avg_ratio) AS avg_excess
FROM p, m
WHERE p.ratio > m.avg_ratio;
WITH p AS (
  SELECT ID,
         AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic,
         AVG(CASE WHEN HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL THEN HGB / HCT END) AS ratio
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
),
m AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS overall_avg FROM p
)
SELECT AVG(p.avg_pic) AS avg_of_avg_pic,
       AVG(p.ratio) AS avg_ratio,
       AVG(p.ratio - m.overall_avg) AS avg_excess
FROM p, m
WHERE p.ratio > m.overall_avg;
WITH p AS (
    SELECT ID,
           AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic,
           AVG(HGB) * 1.0 / AVG(HCT) AS ratio
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
    HAVING AVG(PIC) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(HGB) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(HCT) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(HCT) <> 0
),
t AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS overall FROM p
)
SELECT AVG(p.avg_pic) AS avg_of_avg_pic,
       AVG(p.ratio) AS avg_ratio,
       AVG(p.ratio - t.overall) AS avg_excess
FROM p, t
WHERE p.ratio > t.overall;
WITH p AS (
  SELECT ID, AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic, AVG(HGB) * 1.0 / AVG(HCT) AS ratio
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
  HAVING AVG(HGB) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(HCT) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(HCT) <> 0
),
o AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS overall FROM p
)
SELECT AVG(p.avg_pic) AS avg_pic,
       AVG(p.ratio) AS avg_ratio,
       AVG(p.ratio - o.overall) AS avg_excess
FROM p, o
WHERE p.ratio > o.overall;
